conviction_note: Fundamentals lean to a modest Q3 revenue beat (management promised a sequential step-up in new patient starts and 20+ new territories mature in H2, while the $34.6m bar implies only +8% q/q against +17.5% q/q in the same quarter of 2025), but this name sold its last two beats (Q1 2026 -0.6%, Q2 2026 -5.9% on a revenue beat and GM raise), it ran +21% in five sessions on no news into the print, and Q2 pharmacy revenue carried a stocking effect that can reverse; with no usable option chain, abs_move 10% (below the 12% eight-print median, as the last three prints moved 0.6-5.9%) and p_up 48 give -0.4, while the findings sum to -0.5; the two measurements agree that this is close to a non-result.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $34.59m (10 analysts, range $33.98-35.37m) and EPS -$0.51 (3 analysts), Yahoo Finance analysis page https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BBNX/analysis fetched 2026-10-27; a 2026-09-18 snapshot of the same page read $34.75m (11 analysts). Only ONE estimate source for the quarter, so Q3 findings are capped small. Company's own guide is full-year only: 2026 revenue $131-136m, gross margin 58.5-59.5%, PBP 37-39% of new patient starts, reiterated 2026-07-29 (https://www.drugdeliverybusiness.com/beta-bionics-q2-beats-2026-growth/). FY consensus $133.15m at Earnings Whispers (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/BBNX) sits at the guide midpoint; Yahoo's FY $124.36m is below the guide floor and looks stale. H1 2026 actual $59.6m ($27.6m + $32.0m), so the guide implies H2 $71.4-76.4m; Q3 at $34.6m leaves Q4 at ~$39.3m at the midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest 6,917,021 shares = 16.23% of float, 7.4 days to cover, record date 2026-10-15 (published 2026-10-26), up 14.4% from 6,046,389 on 2026-09-30 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/BBNX/short-interest). Earlier FINRA settlement 2026-08-14: ~7.5m short, 5.5 DTC (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/bbnx/short-interest/). That is a crowded short, building into the print. No skew available: the baseline's option arm returned no_paired_strikes for the 2026-11-20 expiry. One undated search snippet claimed options imply about +/-20%; it has no source and is not used. Tape: +21.36% over 5 sessions, +10.92% over 20, -32.7% from the 52-week high, +143% off the low; spot $21.53 against the $17.25 September offering price. Beta about 3.4 (MarketBeat).

findings.finding: On the Q2 call (2026-07-29) the CFO said 'Q3 will be a step up from Q2' in new patient starts, said the 2025 quarterly shape is 'generally consistent with what we're expecting in 2026', and said the 20+ territories added in H1 begin generating demand about one quarter after onboarding. In 2025 Q3 revenue was +17.5% q/q ($23.2m to $27.25m). The $34.59m Q3 consensus implies only +8% q/q and +27% y/y, after Q2 grew +38% y/y and beat consensus ($32.0m vs ~$31.4-31.5m). My read: Q3 revenue lands ~$35-35.5m, about 2% above the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats have stopped paying: Q2 2026 beat by about 2% with a GM guide raise and the stock fell 5.93%; Q1 2026 beat with a $1m guide raise and it fell 0.57%. Earlier beats paid: Q3 2025 revenue $27.25m vs $23.92m consensus (+14%) and the stock rose 10.34%. The -37% print on 2026-01-08 was a miss on new patient starts.
findings.why_not_priced: If the street had taken management's 2025-shape comment literally, Q3 consensus would sit near $37m (Q2 x 1.175), not $34.6m, and the FY consensus would sit above the guide midpoint, not on it. The 21% five-day run-up partly prices a beat, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base ($27.25m, 5,334 new patient starts) is from the company's own Q3 2025 release: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/35739606/beta-bionics-reports-third-quarter-2025-financial-results-and-raises-full-year-2025-guidance . The Q2 beat size is from https://www.drugdeliverybusiness.com/beta-bionics-q2-beats-2026-growth/ . The q/q guidance shares a transcript with finding 2.

findings.finding: The CFO said Q2 2026 pharmacy-channel (PBP) revenue was 'driven by what I call a stocking dynamic from our pharmacy customers' and that PBP revenue 'can be pretty dramatically impacted based on ordering patterns'. Q2 PBP revenue was $11.6m (+153% y/y) against $10.7m in Q1. DME revenue grew only 9% to $20.4m and was flat-to-down sequentially versus Q3 2025's $21.0m base. A Q3 destock in PBP could leave revenue at or below $34.6m even if new patient starts rise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior PBP destock quarter to read. The January 2026 starts miss was punished at -37%, so a top-line shortfall on this name is sized by the market far above a beat.
findings.why_not_priced: The previews and aggregators carry the $32.0m headline and the +38%; the stocking qualifier sits in the Q&A, not the release. If it were priced, the Q3 bar would show a PBP step-down and the stock would not have run 21% into the print.
findings.independence: Shares a transcript with finding 1, but reads a different line: the timing of pharmacy orders, not patient starts. Q2 channel split from https://www.drugdeliverybusiness.com/beta-bionics-q2-beats-2026-growth/ and https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/beta-bionics-q2-earnings-call-highlights . Both findings can be true together, and they partly offset.

findings.finding: The FY2026 revenue guide of $131-136m was only reiterated on 2026-07-29 despite a Q2 beat. It implies H2 growth of +20-29% y/y against +46% in H1 ($59.6m vs $40.8m). A Q3 near $35m would make the $131m floor look conservative and set up a low-end raise, as the company did in Q1 ($130-135m to $131-136m). The FY consensus ($133.15m) sits at the guide midpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 $1m guide raise met -0.57%. The Q2 2026 reiteration plus a GM guide raise met -5.93%. The Q3 2025 guide raise met +10.34%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the FY consensus already sits at the midpoint, not the top. A raise to $133-137m or more would move the street above midpoint. A cut, for example from a PBP destock, is the downside tail.
findings.independence: The Q1 raise is from the company release: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/1433060/beta-bionics-announces-first-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-raises-full-year-2026-guidance

findings.finding: The stock ran +21.4% in the five sessions into the print with no company news; on 2026-10-26 it was up 9.9% on volume about 48% below average, and MarketBeat named no catalyst. That puts spot at $21.53, 25% above the $17.25 September offering price. Short interest is 16.2% of float with 7.4 days to cover, and it rose 14% in the first half of October. The run-up raises the bar the release has to clear on a name that sold its last two beats. The crowded short is a squeeze mechanism that limits the downside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior case of a 20%+ pre-print run-up in the eight baseline prints. The two most recent beats were sold (-0.57%, -5.93%).
findings.why_not_priced: This is positioning, so it is the price itself. The question is whether a modest beat is enough after +21%. If the run-up had been a reaction to news, there would be a dated catalyst. There is none, and the volume was thin.
findings.independence: Short interest from https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/BBNX/short-interest (record date 2026-10-15). The run-up is from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Peer read: Insulet cut its US outlook on 2026-08-05, attributing about one third of the cut to a slow start in new customer starts and pricing/mix. Tandem's Q2 2026 US pump shipments were about 22,000 against about 21,000 a year earlier (+5%). The US pump market was soft into H2. Neither peer has reported Q3: Tandem reports 2026-11-05 and Insulet has not reported.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BBNX beat in Q2 2026 in the same soft peer quarter (Insulet cut, Tandem flat). Its MDI-conversion mix (about 69% of starts) has decoupled it from peer pump-switch volumes.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It is a two-month-old proxy that BBNX already printed through, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Proxy, not a company number. Tandem Q2 2026 is from https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3712557/tndm-q2-deep-dive-pharmacy-channel-gains-and-pipeline-execution-amid-margin-recovery

findings.finding: Gross margin guidance was raised to 58.5-59.5% on 2026-07-29, after Q1 printed 59.5% helped by what management called 'a couple of one-time gross margin tailwinds'. The rising PBP mix (37-39% of starts) is margin-accretive. A further raise or a print at the top of the range is possible but secondary to starts and revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 GM raise came with a -5.93% reaction, so the line has not paid on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the range was already raised and margin is not the line this name trades on.
findings.independence: Q1 one-time tailwind comment: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/1433060/beta-bionics-announces-first-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-raises-full-year-2026-guidance (company release and call summary). Shares a document with finding 3.

findings.finding: The 3D Intelligence algorithm 510(k) was submitted and is pending; the 2026-09-14 8-K says iLet 3D commercialisation is expected by the end of 2026, subject to FDA clearance. No clearance has been reported as of 2026-10-27, so a clearance or a timing update on the call is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Mint FDA clearance (2026-09-14) lifted the stock: it traded $20.37 (+5.9%) on 2026-09-16 despite a $150m offering priced at $17.25.
findings.why_not_priced: The timing is unknown. A clearance announced with the print would be new; a slip past year-end would be a mild negative. It is binary and has no date, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Pending status was confirmed by HCPLive and RTTNews coverage of the Mint clearance: https://www.rttnews.com/3690706/beta-bionics-fda-clearance-of-mint-sets-stage-for-2027-patch-pump-launch.aspx

findings.finding: FDA overhang: a 2026-01-28 warning letter called the iLet dosing software and ACE pump 'adulterated'. The prospectus of 2026-09-15 cites a post-market surveillance order and 'four open recalls'. On the Q2 call the CEO said complaint handling and post-market surveillance were 'heavily revised'. A close-out or a new observation would be news on the call. No new recall initiated in Aug-Oct 2026 was found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 4.9% on 2026-02-24, when the FDA published the warning letter (per the class-action complaint).
findings.why_not_priced: The status is in the price as an open overhang. Neither direction is evidenced, so the size is zero.
findings.independence: Warning letter coverage: https://www.drugdeliverybusiness.com/beta-bionics-receives-fda-warning-letter/ . The remediation comment is from the Q2 transcript, https://www.webull.com/news/15364580160791552

findings.finding: Financing: a $150.0m offering was priced 2026-09-15 at $17.25 (7.65m shares plus 1.04m pre-funded warrants, about 52.6m shares outstanding after). Proceeds fund the Mint patch-pump launch (full US launch Q1 2027, capacity for at least 1.5m disposables in 2027) and manufacturing expansion. With June 30 cash of $225.2m this removes the funding question. The money buys a dated launch, not a going-concern fix.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock traded higher after pricing (+5.9% on 2026-09-16) and now sits 25% above the deal price.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced. It is filed so the panel sees that the balance sheet is not a print risk. 2027 opex for the Mint launch could come up on the call.

outside_window.finding: Lead-plaintiff deadline in Holtzman v. Beta Bionics (C.D. Cal. 2:26-cv-09999; class period 2025-07-30 to 2026-02-24) falls after the window; the law-firm notices carry no new operational information.
Tandem Diabetes reports Q3 2026 on 2026-11-05, so the peer read on US pump demand and the pharmacy channel lands after the window.
Mint patch pump full US commercial launch is guided for Q1 2027, and the offering lock-up runs past the window.

baseline_tension: The fundamental lean (a modest beat and a possible low-end guide raise) agrees with the +21% five-day and +11% twenty-day run-up, so much of it is likely already in the price. With no skew to read and a crowded, building short (16% of float, 7.4 days to cover), the reaction is close to a coin flip with a fat tail either way, which pulls p_up to 48.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the Q3 consensus has one estimate source (Yahoo, two snapshots), so the reported-quarter beat finding was capped from +1.0 to +0.8 and p_up moved from 47 to 48.

Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction) and lesson 7 (a crowded short shrinks a negative) were already applied in the draft: beats sold in Q1/Q2 2026 kept finding 1 small, and the 16% short interest had already cut the run-up finding from -1.5 to -1.0. They were not applied a second time.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the $150m raise funds a dated Mint launch, so it stays at 0, as in the draft.
Lesson 3 (read the set): findings 1 and 2 share a transcript but read different lines (patient starts against pharmacy order timing); both can be true, so they stay separate and partly offset.
